content: Implement controller and validation schemas for GET /api/users/:id with field-level access control
activeForm: Implementing controller and validation schemas for GET /api/users/:id with field-level access control
description: Implement user.controller.ts with getUserProfile method that handles GET /api/users/:id endpoint. Implements field-level access control (own profile shows email/phone, other profiles exclude them). Create Zod validation schemas for parameter validation (ID must be positive integer). Write 15-20 MVP-tier tests (unit tests for controller logic and field filtering, integration tests for controller-repository interaction). This subtask uses the repository layer from T1.1 and will be integrated with routes in T1.3.

checkpoints.name: Validation Schemas Complete
checkpoints.requirement: Zod validation schemas created and tested for ID parameter validation (positive integer)

checkpoints.name: Controller Implementation with Tests
checkpoints.requirement: Controller implementation complete with first 8 unit tests passing (field filtering logic verified)

phases.name: Validation Schema Implementation
actions: Export: schemas for route integration in T1.3
Test: parameter validation with valid/invalid IDs
phases.gate: Schemas must validate INTEGER IDs (not UUIDs) before proceeding

phases.name: Controller Implementation
actions: Implement: Field filtering logic (if req.user.id === userId, show all; else exclude email/phone)
Return: 200 with user object or 404 if user not found
Exclude: password_hash is already excluded by repository

phases.name: MVP Test Suite (18 tests)
actions: Write: 10 unit tests for controller methods and field filtering logic
Write: 8 integration tests for controller-repository interaction and access control
Verify: All 18 tests passing with 90%+ coverage of controller layer
